patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models/deletion.py b/django/db/models/deletion.py
index ae82d26340..102c941a28 100644
--- a/django/db/models/deletion.py
+++ b/django/db/models/deletion.py
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@ from operator import attrgetter
 
 from django.db import IntegrityError, connections, transaction
 from django.db.models import signals, sql
+from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
 
 
 class ProtectedError(IntegrityError):
@@ -214,6 +215,10 @@ class Collector:
         if collect_related:
             if keep_parents:
                 parents = set(model._meta.get_parent_list())
+            # Querysets of related objects that can be fast-deleted are grouped
+            # by model and source batch so that queries deleting from the same
+            # table can be combined into a single query using an OR clause.
+            fast_delete_groups = {}
             for related in get_candidate_relations_to_delete(model._meta):
                 # Preserve parent reverse relationships if keep_parents=True.
                 if keep_parents and related.model in parents:
@@ -225,7 +230,10 @@ class Collector:
                 for batch in batches:
                     sub_objs = self.related_objects(related, batch)
                     if self.can_fast_delete(sub_objs, from_field=field):
-                        self.fast_deletes.append(sub_objs)
+                        related_model = related.related_model
+                        key = (related_model, tuple(obj.pk for obj in batch))
+                        fast_delete_groups.setdefault(key, []).append(
+                            (field, batch, sub_objs))
                     else:
                         related_model = related.related_model
                         # Non-referenced fields can be deferred if no signal
@@ -243,6 +251,16 @@ class Collector:
                             sub_objs = sub_objs.only(*tuple(referenced_fields))
                         if sub_objs:
                             field.remote_field.on_delete(self, field, sub_objs, self.using)
+            for (related_model, _), entries in fast_delete_groups.items():
+                if len(entries) > 1:
+                    combined_q = Q()
+                    for field, batch, _ in entries:
+                        combined_q |= Q(**{"%s__in" % field.name: batch})
+                    self.fast_deletes.append(
+                        related_model._base_manager.using(self.using).filter(combined_q)
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self.fast_deletes.append(entries[0][2])
             for field in model._meta.private_fields:
                 if hasattr(field, 'bulk_related_objects'):
                     # It's something like generic foreign key.
